snapshot.stmt:
Fix \(n\ge2\) and \(p\ne q\) in \([\varepsilon,1-\varepsilon]\), and put
\[
 \Delta=\frac{q-p}{\sqrt{p(1-p)}},
 \qquad c=\Delta^2.
\]
On \(\mathcal H_n^{\mathrm{hub}}\), the Loomba--Eckles transport weights and the smallest uniform bounded-class envelope satisfy
\[
 W_1^{\mathrm{LE}}
 =1+\Delta\sum_{j=1}^n\chi_{1,\{j\}}^{\pi},
 \qquad
 W_i^{\mathrm{LE}}=1+\Delta\chi_{i,\{i\}}^{\pi}\quad(2\le i\le n),
\]
\[
 B_n^{\mathrm{LE}}=1+nc,
 \qquad D_n^{\mathrm{LE}}=n-1,
 \qquad
 \frac{B_n^{\mathrm{LE}}(D_n^{\mathrm{LE}}+1)}{n}=1+nc=\Theta(n).
\]

defs.def:hub-family: For \(n\ge2\), set \(\pi_j=p\), \(\pi'_j=q\), \(\Gamma_1=V_n\), \(\mathcal S_1=\{\varnothing\}\cup\{\{j\}:j\in V_n\}\), and for \(i\ge2\) set \(\Gamma_i=\{i\}\) and \(\mathcal S_i=\{\varnothing,\{i\}\}\).
defs.def:local-fourier-character: For \(x\in X_i\) and \(U\subseteq\Gamma_i\), set \(\chi_{i,U}^{\pi}(x)=\prod_{j\in U}(x_j-\pi_j)/\sqrt{\pi_j(1-\pi_j)}\), with \(\chi_{i,\varnothing}^{\pi}=1\).
defs.def:loomba-eckles-spectral-envelope:
For every fixed instance, define the Fourier policy-shift coefficient by
\[
 \Delta_U^{\pi,\pi'}
 =\prod_{j\in U}\frac{\pi'_j-\pi_j}{\sqrt{\pi_j(1-\pi_j)}},
 \qquad \Delta_{\varnothing}^{\pi,\pi'}=1,
\]
and define the Loomba--Eckles EAO transport weight for unit \(i\) by
\[
 W_i^{\mathrm{LE}}(z)
 =\sum_{U\in\mathcal S_i}
   \Delta_U^{\pi,\pi'}\chi_{i,U}^{\pi}(z_{\Gamma_i}).
\]
The smallest uniform bounded-class second-moment envelope and the overlap degree are
\[
 B_n^{\mathrm{LE}}
 =\max_{i\in V_n}\ \sup_{v_i\in K_i}
   \sum_{z\in\Omega_n}p_{\pi}(z)
   \bigl(v_i(z_{\Gamma_i})W_i^{\mathrm{LE}}(z)\bigr)^2
\]
and
\[
 D_n^{\mathrm{LE}}
 =\max_{i\in V_n}
   \left|\left\{j\in V_n\setminus\{i\}:
   \Gamma_i\cap\Gamma_j\ne\varnothing\right\}\right|.
\]
Thus \(B_n^{\mathrm{LE}}\) is the least number \(B\) for which every bounded schedule in \(K\) satisfies the unitwise second-moment premise of the Loomba--Eckles spectral-overlap theorem.

\[

Under the fixed-instance abbreviations \(E=E_n\), \(K=K_n\), \(N_z=N_{n,z}\), and \(\ell=\ell_n\), these same formulas define \(\psi_z(M)\) and \(\mathcal D\).
defs.def:treewidth-handle: Lift rank-one schedule moments to bag-local moments on a tree decomposition of \(\mathcal I\), carry the target-sum epigraph as a separator statistic, and eliminate assignment variables only after proving that optimal weights and moment consistency admit bag-local representatives.

assumptions.ass:hierarchical-support: Each retained support is downward closed: if \(U\in\mathcal S_i\) and \(W\subseteq U\), then \(W\in\mathcal S_i\).
assumptions.ass:source-overlap: The source probabilities satisfy \(\varepsilon\le\pi_j\le1-\varepsilon\) for every \(j\in V_n\).
assumptions.ass:source-product-design: The source assignment mass satisfies \(p_{\pi}(z)=\prod_{j\in V_n}\pi_j^{z_j}(1-\pi_j)^{1-z_j}\) for every \(z\in\Omega_n\).
assumptions.ass:fourier-membership: For every \(i\in V_n\), the local schedule satisfies \(v_i\in H_i\).
